user.title: Connect to Infuse
user.description: Enable Now Playing API in Infuse > Settings > Playback. For **posters**, you can optionally enter a **TMDB API Read Access Token** below. Playback metadata works locally without a token. You can also add the token later in Configure. [Get a TMDB token](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api).

confirm.description: Use the discovered local Infuse Now Playing API for {name} at {host}:{port}. [Get a TMDB token](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api).

init.title: Infuse settings
init.description: If no TMDB token is configured and you want posters, enter your API Read Access Token. Leaving the token blank keeps an existing one. Playback metadata remains local without a token. [Get a TMDB token](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api).
